archetypes.name: waterfall-contracts
archetypes.rationale: The plan changes multiple dispatcher fallback/drop semantics where small contract mismatches can invalidate the review panel behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit the proposed dispatch-panel changes against existing waterfall, plan-review, and code-review dispatcher contracts. Focus on whether conditional --no-fallback, CODEX availability, dropped-slot forwarding, and partial-peer failure handling are planned against the actual stdout keys and caller expectations. Check that the plan does not import /design semantics where /review deliberately differs. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: slot-accounting
archetypes.rationale: The 6-to-4 collapse plus both-vendor expansion makes denominator, dynamic-slot, and failure-threshold drift likely.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace every planned static and dynamic slot count from manifest emission through review-core threshold invocation and tally attribution. Look for off-by-one, stale default, dynamic Codex basename, dropped-row, or availability-gating holes that could make the written plan's 4-slot and 8-slot assumptions false. Verify the proposed tests cover the exact accounting edges they claim to protect. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: prompt-artifacts
archetypes.rationale: The fold of plan-fidelity into testing depends on prompt rendering and generated prompt artifacts staying consistent.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the plan gives reviewer-testing enough plan context after folding plan-fidelity while avoiding accidental context expansion for unrelated reviewers. Check render-specialist-prompt behavior, pre-rendered prompt regeneration, hand-maintained agent files, and tests for consistency with the claimed runtime prompt surface. Hunt for stale generated-vs-hand-maintained assumptions or missing artifact updates. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: operator-doc-sync
archetypes.rationale: The plan touches many user-facing docs and topology phrases, creating a high risk of stale operator guidance.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the proposed canonical wording and behavior changes against the listed docs, topology generator, diagram, and quick-mode sync harness. Look for missing documentation surfaces, contradictory fallback matrices, stale '6 Cursor specialists' phrasing, or operator-experience gaps around degraded both-vendor and both-down cases. Prioritize inconsistencies that would mislead a contributor running or debugging /review or /implement. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
